_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_JNS).

levels.name: Ground level: platforms 1–3, and the ground floor of Asemaparkki (waiting area, R-kioski, WC, taxi, drop-off)
levels.name_source: https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/joensuu, read 2026-10-30; City of Joensuu, "Railway and bus station", https://www.joensuu.fi/en/city-and-development/our-joensuu/arriving-in-joensuu/railway-and-bus-station/, read 2026-10-30; JOJO (Joensuu public transport), "Long-distance coaches", https://jojo.joensuu.fi/en/timetables-routes-and-zones/other-public-transport-connections/, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-JNS/_report.json and joensuu_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joensuu_railway_station, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Overpass (ylikulku) level: footbridge over the tracks next to Asemaparkki
levels.name_source: City of Joensuu, "Railway and bus station", https://www.joensuu.fi/en/city-and-development/our-joensuu/arriving-in-joensuu/railway-and-bus-station/, read 2026-10-30; JOJO (Joensuu public transport), "Long-distance coaches", https://jojo.joensuu.fi/en/timetables-routes-and-zones/other-public-transport-connections/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-JNS.json), read 2026-10-30

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_JNS).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 1 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_JNS).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.2597099, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 265 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

2–3._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.4384580, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 2, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 320 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

structures.name: roof over the platforms (traced from the laser)
structures._source: Outline traced from the laser alone (1 m cells holding unclassified points 2.4–14 m above the platform surface over the BanInfo platforms, outside OSM outlines, closed 3×3, simplified 0.7 m); Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, newest per sheet (clack_fi_mml05_N5424G3), Maanmittauslaitos (National Land Survey of Finland), CC BY 4.0; scanned N5424G3 2024-08-06 (20240203_Swissphoto_Joensuu_kesa); from data/stations/research/fi_JNS/joensuu_structures_heights.geojson (metres above the platform surface, 81.26 m RH 2000, laser 2024-08-06); underside not measured

terrain._source: ground from the laser's ground points, 1 m (data/stations/research/fi_JNS/joensuu_ground_1m.tif), sampled every 5 m; Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0. Heights above the platform surface (81.26 m N2000, laser 2024-08-06)

pois._source: City of Joensuu, "Railway and bus station", https://www.joensuu.fi/en/city-and-development/our-joensuu/arriving-in-joensuu/railway-and-bus-station/, read 2026-10-30; JOJO (Joensuu public transport), "Long-distance coaches", https://jojo.joensuu.fi/en/timetables-routes-and-zones/other-public-transport-connections/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-JNS.json), read 2026-10-30; placed OSM node n11275686118 (research pass 2026-10-30, data/stations/research/fi_JNS/station_facts.json)
